title: Jean-Claude Van Johnson
production_companies: Scott Free ProductionsJittery Dog ProductionsAmazon Studios
premise_summary: Jean-Claude Van Johnson is an American action comedy-drama television series starring Jean-Claude Van Damme and produced by Ridley Scott with his production studio Scott Free Productions and Amazon Studios. It premiered on August 19, 2016. On January 18, 2018, the series was cancelled after one season. It received generally positive reviews from critics.
